Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: "DNA"
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 41.159261, -75.383050 (Approximated from route)
Report Description
THE REPORTING SOURCE STATED THAT THE DRINKING WATER (PARK SEPTIC SYSTEM) WAS TESTED AND RECEIVED POSITIVE RESULTS FOR CHLOROFORM (29MAY2018). THE RP STATED THAT THIS WAS A POSSIBLE CROSS CONTAMINATION FOR PIPING THAT WAS EXCAVATED. ON 08JUN2018, THE SRP SHOCKED THE WATER SUPPLY WITHOUT NOTIFYING THE CITIZENS IN THE COMMUNITY AND THE WATER CURRENTLY SMELLS LIKE BLEACH. THE RP ALLEGED THAT ONE OF THE CURRENT STATE REPRESENTATIVES NOTIFIED THE SEWER DIVISION AND THEY WERE ADVISED TO DISTRIBUTE 24 CASES OF BOTTLED WATER TO THE COMMUNITY. THE RP ALSO STATED THAT SHE HAS BEEN SICK FOR THE PAST 3 MONTHS AND SUSPECTS THE WATER IS RESPONSIBLE. A GROUNDHOG DRANK THE WATER AND ALLEGEDLY DIED.
